messages:
sam: heads-up: deploying response-serve-v2 (model) at 11:00Z. plan: feature flag 'route_v2' phased ramp + model pin v2.4.1. include KV warmup and a short token-cost smoke. keeping deploy window 11:00-11:50.

deploy-bot: accepted. scheduled start 2026-04-02T11:00Z. auto-rollback triggers: 5xx_rate > 0.7% sustained 3m OR p95 latency increase > 180ms. will report checkpoints every 5m.

nina: propose micro-canary: 0.2% (internal) -> 1% (internal+beta) -> 7% (mixed) -> 30% -> 100%. hold 5m between each step. smaller steps help catch regressions.

carl: +1. Also please cap CPU-bound hosts to 25 rps during initial phases. and exclude region-apac for first hour.

maria: last time we saw token-cost regressions with v2.x. add metric for tokens-per-response and cost-delta alert if >+8%.

sam: good call. include an eval set run on canary traffic to track brevity/regression.

ops-bot: created ramp dashboard: https://internal/boards/response-serve-ramp (placeholder). alerts: tokens_per_resp_delta>8% OR 5xx>0.6% -> notify #eng-oncall and #sre.

release-bot: reminder: include release notes: brief change in stopping criteria for multi-step completions and pinned model v2.4.1. add rollback instructions.

deploy-bot: initial canary applied at 11:02Z to cohort internal-canary (0.2%). KV warmup job started on canary nodes.

nina: KV warmup logs look clean. cold-miss rate dropped to <0.1%.

deploy-bot: checkpoint @11:07Z: no 5xx anomaly, p95 +18ms, tokens_per_resp +2%. advancing to 1% (internal+beta) at 11:08Z.

carl: starting external-sample at 1% now, still excluding apac.

maria: small spike in token-cost on one shard, investigating. looks like longer completions for a subset of prompts.

sam: pause advancement until token-cost stabilizes. hold at 1% for 10m.

deploy-bot: hold enforced. will re-check at 11:18Z.

maria: root cause: system prompt length mismatch on a routing rule for ephemeral-chat; pushing a config patch to align prompt truncation. expected fix in ~3m.

nina: after patch, run a small synthetic throughput run on canary to validate.

ops-bot: synthetic run executed @11:22Z; p95 back to baseline+12ms, tokens delta now +1.5%.

deploy-bot: advancing to 7% mixed traffic at 11:25Z. will cap to 100 rps for this phase.

sam: aim to reach 30% over next 15m, then 100% if green. keep model pinned to v2.4.1 for 60m post-100%.

release-bot: note for changelog: "route_v2 flag: enabled gradually with staged canary; model pinned v2.4.1; KV warmup step added."

carl: ops prepared rollback snippet if needed:
```
/deploybot toggle --flag route_v2 --off --reason "regression-sev"
/deploybot pin model response-serve --version v2.3.9
```

deploy-bot: advanced to 30% at 11:40Z. monitoring. no alerts fired.

maria: running post-rollout smoke now. p50/p95 look stable. token-cost delta steady at +1.2%.

sam: proceed to 100% after a 5m final sanity check.

ops-bot: final sanity OK. no alert rules tripped.

sam: toggled route_v2 to 100% at 11:46Z. model remains pinned to v2.4.1 for monitoring window. thanks team.

nina: will follow-up with perf and cost summary in the release thread.

maria: tagging this as "no rollback" unless new alerts in next 60m.

carl: noted. good job.

sam: closing thread after post-window summary. will add release note link.
